title: The Spirit and Mission
sourceBasis: World English Bible — 66-book Old and New Testament Scripture text already installed in Iron Sharpener
definition: The Spirit and mission teaches that the Holy Spirit empowers God’s people for witness, evangelism, boldness, and Gospel proclamation. Mission is carried out by the Spirit’s power, not human strength alone.
summary: The Spirit and mission teaches that the Holy Spirit empowers God’s people for witness, evangelism, boldness, and Gospel proclamation. Mission is carried out by the Spirit’s power, not human strength alone.
christFocus: The risen Christ sends His people to bear witness, and the Spirit gives power to proclaim Him. The Spirit’s mission is to make Christ known through the Gospel to the nations.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Jesus promised that His followers would receive power when the Holy Spirit came upon them and that they would be His witnesses. The Spirit empowers proclamation of Christ from local places to the ends of the earth.

The Spirit directs mission. In Acts, the Spirit set apart workers and sent them out for Gospel ministry. Mission is not merely human strategy; it is obedience to Christ under the Spirit’s guidance.

The Spirit gives boldness. When believers prayed, they were filled with the Spirit and spoke the Word with courage. This boldness is not personality-driven confidence, but God-given strength to witness faithfully.

The Spirit’s mission always centers on the Gospel of Christ. He does not empower self-promotion, entertainment, or empty religious activity, but faithful witness to Jesus.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Many believers feel too weak, afraid, ordinary, or unqualified to witness. This doctrine reminds them that mission has always depended on God’s power, not human impressiveness.

It also keeps ministry from becoming mere marketing or platform-building. The Spirit empowers witness so Christ is proclaimed and disciples are made.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Ask the Holy Spirit for boldness and faithfulness in witness. Speak of Christ with humility and courage, serve where God sends you, and depend on the Spirit rather than charisma, pressure, or technique. Let mission begin with prayer and continue in obedience.
